exposure: institutional level (secondary vs. tertiary midwifery hospitals)
cohort: 324 mothers with SPPH from 9 tertiary and 10 secondary midwifery hospitals in Beijing, China
finding: A high proportion of SPPH cases, particularly in secondary hospitals, lacked identifiable antenatal risk factors, highlighting the need for improved SPPH rescue capacity across all levels of care.
mod_finding: This study investigated the characteristics and treatment approaches for severe postpartum hemorrhage (SPPH) in relation to different delivery modes.
